name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. He initially pursued a career in architecture, but a weekend volunteering at a local racing event ignited a passion for the intricate engineering behind the roaring engines. He transitioned, taking night classes in mechanical engineering while working as a draughtsman during the day. This dedication led him to a position at a small engineering firm specializing in race car components, where he honed his skills in quality assurance.

His approach to quality control is meticulous and proactive. He believes that identifying potential issues early is key to preventing costly and time-consuming setbacks on the track. Alistair is known for his keen eye for detail and his ability to communicate technical findings effectively to both engineers and management. His unique blend of architectural precision and engineering acumen makes him a valuable asset in maintaining the highest standards of performance and reliability.

Alistair's strength lies in his ability to see the big picture while simultaneously focusing on the minute details, ensuring that every component meets stringent specifications before it ever makes it onto the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a wiry build, often seen wearing glasses perched on his nose.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
